description: Dart source file defining the main ReactAgentScreen widget for a Flutter app, including UI components, state management, and settings.

classes.name: ReactAgentScreen
classes.description: Main screen widget for the ReAct Agent Flutter app, managing user interactions, displaying steps, and settings.

classes.name: _SettingsResult
classes.description: Simple data class for returning the result of the settings modal, mainly a status message.

classes.name: _ReactAgentScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the internal state and UI logic of ReactAgentScreen, including user input, step list, debug panel, and settings interactions.

classes.name: _SettingsSheet
classes.description: Widget for the bottom sheet allowing user to configure settings like API key and mode.

classes.name: _SettingsSheetState
classes.description: State class for managing the form and actions within the _SettingsSheet, including save and clear API key.

classes.name: _DebugOverlayPanel
classes.description: Overlay widget displaying debugging information such as steps and internal state.

classes.name: _DebugChip
classes.description: Small widget showing a label and value for debugging purposes.

classes.name: _PrimaryActionButton
classes.description: Styled button widget used for starting the agent, showing progress and enabling/disabling based on state.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes controllers and sets up listeners for the main screen.

methods.name: _onChanged
methods.description: Listener callback that updates UI when the controller's state changes.

methods.name: _toggleDebugPanel
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the debug overlay panel.

methods.name: _openSettingsSheet
methods.description: Opens a modal bottom sheet for user to adjust settings. Handles asynchronous result.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Ensures snack bars are shown when needed after dependency changes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main UI layout of the react agent screen.

methods.name: _buildHeader
methods.description: Constructs the top header section with title, mode indicator, and user input field.

methods.name: _buildSteps
methods.description: Builds list view of steps processed by the agent.

methods.name: _buildEmpty
methods.description: Displays a placeholder when no steps are present.
